heroHeadline: Russia-Ukraine Abu Dhabi Talks End With Prisoner-Swap Deal in Principle but No Ceasefire Breakthrough
heroSubtitle: November 11, 2026 — Two days of US-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi, the first Russia-Ukraine round since February, ended with an agreement in principle on a large prisoner exchange that Russian officials say could occur within two to three weeks. There was no progress on a ceasefire, territory or security guarantees, and Europe was excluded from the room. US envoys Kushner and Witkoff plan to meet Putin in Moscow and then Zelenskyy.
footerNote: Data sourced from UN, African Union, IGAD, Crisis Group, USIP, PA-X Database, and Tier 1–3 sources across all media poles.
